text:
samir_devx: quick idea thread 11 proposing a lightweight 'mini-module publishing playbook' for cloud partners. core: tiny terraform modules, 1-click quickstarts, CI smoke tests, and a standard artifact for marketplace intake. goal: make partner reviews fast and consistent.
elaine_partners: yes please. partners need a demo that works in <30m, clear minimal IAM scopes, and a billing_tag example. include suggested partner copy for README. :sparkles:
toni_infra: constraints: modules must be single-purpose, <=6 resources, expose variables: env, region (alias), instance_type, common_tags. use HCL idioms only; keep provider pins minimal. add a compat manifest.
gina_eng: repo layout recommendation: `mini-modules/<service>/` plus `examples/{aws,gcp,azure}/demo/` and `ci/publish.yml`. include LICENSE, MAINTAINERS, and terraform-docs output. README TL;DR at top with 3 steps.
jordan_ci: CI flow: tflint + fmt, terraform init && plan -out=plan.tfplan, terraform apply -auto-approve, smoke-runner container hits output.endpoint, terraform destroy -auto-approve. run each cloud example in separate jobs to avoid cred bleed; matrix arch [x86_64, arm64].
matt_sre: smoke job must destroy on failure and export logs. recommend retry/backoff for API calls and a quota-check helper. include a Dedicated fallback pointer in README.
alex_partner: from partner POV: docs must include copy/paste CLI for booth demos and a tiny sample app (node or python) that calls Redwood Hosted API with example api key placeholder. also include co-branding guidelines.
samir_devx: packaging: produce a zip containing module, examples, generated docs, compat.yml, and metadata file with support_email + billing_tag. naming convention: `{service}-{shortsha}.zip`. Redwood will publish initial artifact to partner marketplace; partners can fork for updates.
infra-bot: [automation] staged artifact created: gs://redwood-marketplace-staging/mini/http-proxy-1795000000-abc123.zip (sha256: a3f5c6d7).
gina_eng: I'll prototype `ci/publish.yml` that runs terraform-docs, builds zip, uploads to staging, and calls infra-bot. will include a `compat-check.sh` that validates terraform version and provider constraints.
toni_infra: compat.yml should list tested regions, architectures, provider versions, and a maintainer contact. add `compat-check.sh` POSIX script so partners can run locally.
jordan_ci: timeline: prototype CI + sample for AWS by EOD Fri, GCP/Azure parity next week, partner review slot in 2 weeks. owners: samir_devx (program), gina_eng (repo+CI), toni_infra (compat), elaine_partners (partner docs).
matt_sre: one more ask: add a simple smoke test harness snippet to README so partners can run smoke locally without CI.
samir_devx: thanks all. i'll open repo skeleton PR and include a PR template for partner reviews. please add short review comments, mark non-blocking items with :eyes:.
